steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Establish the root architecture for AI File Companion utilizing Gradle 8.5 and Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2.

steps.title: Define Build Settings
steps.description: Configure compilation parameters targeting Android SDK 34 with standard Java 8 source/target compatibility rules.

steps.title: Configure App Manifest
steps.description: Define permissions including INTERNET, register the launcher MainActivity, and apply the lightweight Material Light theme.

steps.title: Develop Main User Interface Layout
steps.description: Build an absolute standard-SDK-compliant layout featuring custom navigation tabs, AI chat, file management layout, and API parameters.

steps.title: Establish Base Activity Structure
steps.description: Initialize the Android lifecycle within MainActivity.java and link local variables to standard Android system widgets.

steps.title: Implement Navigation Tab Switching Logic
steps.description: Program standard visibility transitions among the AI Workspace, Saved Files vault, and API Settings screens.

steps.title: Build File Storage Core Engine
steps.description: Implement file creation, local stream persistence, modification, retrieval, and removal routines in internal storage.

steps.title: Construct Interactive Files Adapter
steps.description: Craft an optimized standard BaseAdapter to display persistent files along with immediate options to view, modify, attach, or delete.

steps.title: Program Interactive File Editor Pane
steps.description: Develop UI fields and validation mechanics allowing the user to create new document entities or update current ones instantly.

steps.title: Integrate Dynamic Chat Rendering Flow
steps.description: Create a dynamically populated vertical layout supporting user text rendering, file attachment tags, and styled system response blocks.

steps.title: Implement Safe API Network Call Routine
steps.description: Design a strict background thread network worker using HttpURLConnection to interact with Gemini LLM APIs without blocking UI.

steps.title: Embed Simulated AI Engine
steps.description: Equip the app with a local analytical processing system that reads attached file schemas and outputs dynamic diagnostic data if keys are absent.

steps.title: Configure SharedPreferences Settings
steps.description: Incorporate key-value configurations to save custom API Keys and mode presets securely across app lifecycles.

steps.title: Validate Namespace and Compilation Rules
steps.description: Fix layout parameter capitalization to WRAP_CONTENT to solve compiler exceptions, and clean up AndroidManifest package parameters.

steps.title: Building AI File Companion
steps.description: Perform full app package compilation into standard debuggable binary via Gradle command parameters.
